result.summary: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses using send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall. It introduces PaymentDestination to handle dynamic derivation of taproot scriptPubKeys from spending input private keys, updates coin selection to ensure derivation-eligible inputs are selected, and persists recipient destinations to the wallet database to enable RBF fee-bumping. Operations that cannot safely derive keys or support subsequent fee bumps (such as PSBT creation, external signers, and unpersisted transactions) are prohibited.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core users cannot send to BIP 352 silent payment addresses. Because silent payment output scripts are not static and instead depend on the private keys of the chosen inputs, standard destination types, coin selection, and transaction creation routines cannot generate or fee-bump them.
evidence: PR description: 'Silent Payments logic: PaymentDestination is added to contain CTxDestination or SilentPaymentsDestination; coin selection logic for silent payments requires at least one shared secret derivation-eligible coin to be present in the result set; recipient silent payments destinations are now persisted to the wallet to make it possible to RBF.'

Commit d172d42379: 'CreateSilentPaymentsOutputs... sums the private keys of the eligible selected inputs and derives the taproot outputs of the silent payments destinations. Fail if no selected input is eligible, or if the key of an eligible input is missing, instead of creating outputs the recipient cannot find.'
result.scope_notes: Touches core wallet transaction construction, coin selection, fee-bumping, and wallet storage schemas (`sprecipients`). Includes over 1,300 lines of functional and unit test additions, including a BIP 352 scanning test framework.
result.changed_since_previous: The 11-commit structure remains focused on payment destinations, coin selection, output derivation, fee-bumping, and test coverage; changes represent rebases and minor adjustments to transaction construction and test helpers.
result.card: Adds wallet and RPC support for sending transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses via send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall. Bitcoin Core wallet users cannot currently pay silent payment addresses, preventing adoption of reusable privacy-preserving addresses. The PR introduces PaymentDestination to abstract dynamic taproot output derivation, updates coin selection to require shared-secret-eligible inputs, and stores recipient destinations to permit RBF fee-bumping. Operations unable to guarantee safe fee-bumping or key derivation (such as PSBT export or external signers) are rejected. This is the second iteration of #28201, part of tracking issue #28536, and depends on #35301.

risk.why: Mistakes in calculating silent payment shared secrets, handling private keys during output generation, or storing destination records could cause unspendable outputs, loss of funds, or corrupt fee-bumping.
